privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
Your privacy is important to us. Please review Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom’s Privacy Policy below.

Last Updated: March 14, 2026

Who We Are

Our website address is https://tombellcabinetry.com. Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom provides custom cabinetry, woodworking, and remodeling services.

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site, we collect the data shown in the comments form along with the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help detect spam.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to determine whether you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available at https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture may be visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS). Visitors to the website may be able to download and extract location data from images on the site.

Cookies

If you leave a comment on our site, you may opt in to saving your name, email address, and website in cookies. These cookies are for your convenience so you do not have to fill in your details again when leaving another comment. These cookies typically remain active for one year.

If you visit our login page, a temporary cookie may be set to determine whether your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we may set cookies to save your login information and screen display preferences. Login cookies typically last two days, and display preference cookies last for one year. If you select “Remember Me,” your login may persist for two weeks. Logging out removes login cookies.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie may be stored in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the ID of the post that was edited. It expires after one day.

Embedded Content from Other Websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content such as videos, images, or articles from other websites. Embedded content behaves the same as if you visited the external website directly.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking technologies, and monitor your interaction with the embedded content.

SMS Messaging Program

Customers may opt in to receive email and SMS text message communications through our website, including the contact form located at https://tombellcabinetry.com/contact/, or through other promotions and events.

By providing your phone number and opting in, you consent to receive SMS messages from Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom regarding appointment reminders, project updates, service notifications, and occasional promotional messages. Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of purchase.

Message frequency varies, but promotional messages will not exceed one message per week. Appointment reminders may be sent approximately 48 hours and 1 hour prior to scheduled appointments.

You may opt out of SMS messages at any time by replying STOP to any message. After sending STOP, you will receive a confirmation message and will no longer receive SMS messages from us. To rejoin, you may sign up again through the original opt-in method.

If you experience issues with the messaging program, reply HELP or contact us at sales@tombellcabinetry.com or call/text (615) 469-2781.

Message and data rates may apply for messages sent to you from us and from you to us. Message frequency varies. Please contact your wireless provider for questions regarding your text or data plan.

Wireless carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Who We Share Your Data With

If you request a password reset, your IP address may be included in the reset email.

Mobile phone numbers and SMS opt-in information will not be sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes. Information may be shared with trusted service providers who support our business operations (such as email, messaging, or customer service platforms) solely for the purpose of delivering services on our behalf.

How Long We Retain Your Data

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata may be retained indefinitely to allow us to recognize and automatically approve follow-up comments.

If users register on our website, we store the personal information they provide in their user profile. Users can view, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except usernames). Website administrators may also access and edit that information.

Your Data Rights

If you have an account on this site or have left comments, you may request an exported file of the personal data we hold about you. You may also request that we delete any personal data we hold about you, except for data we are required to retain for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where Your Data Is Sent

Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service. We may also transmit data through secure API connections to trusted third-party systems such as Mailchimp, GoHighLevel, and similar platforms to support communication with customers.

We do not sell your personal information.

Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal information from loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Information submitted through our website, including contact forms and SMS opt-ins, is transmitted using secure encryption protocols (such as HTTPS) and stored on secure systems.

Access to personal information is restricted to authorized personnel and service providers who require access to perform legitimate business functions and who are obligated to maintain confidentiality. While no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, we follow industry-standard practices to protect the integrity and confidentiality of personal data.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
By accessing our website, requesting a quote, or engaging our services, you agree to the following Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

Last Updated: March 14, 2026

1. Use of Our Website

This website is provided for informational purposes only. By using it, you agree to use the site lawfully and respectfully. You may not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, or interfere with its operation.

All content on this site – including text, images, logos, designs, and layouts – is the property of Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom and may not be copied, reproduced, or distributed without written permission.

2. Estimates, Proposals & Pricing

All estimates and proposals are non-binding until a written agreement is signed by both parties. Pricing may change due to material availability, custom selections, scope changes, or site conditions. Any changes requested after a proposal is approved may result in adjusted pricing and timelines.

We believe in transparency and will always communicate changes clearly before proceeding.

3. Scope of Services

Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom provides custom cabinetry, kitchen remodeling, woodworking, and related renovation services. Specific scope, materials, timelines, and responsibilities will be outlined in your individual contract or proposal.

We do not guarantee outcomes beyond what is expressly stated in writing.

4. Scheduling & Project Timelines

Project timelines are estimates and may be affected by factors outside our control, including supply chain delays, weather conditions, permit approvals, client-requested changes, and site readiness.

We make every reasonable effort to stay on schedule and communicate proactively if adjustments are required.

5. Client Responsibilities

Clients agree to provide accurate information about the project site and existing conditions, ensure timely access to the property as agreed, make selections and approvals promptly to avoid delays, and maintain a safe work environment during construction.

Failure to meet these responsibilities may impact timelines or costs.

6. Payments & Deposits

Payment terms, deposits, and milestone schedules will be outlined in your project agreement. Late payments may result in work delays or additional fees as permitted by law. All payments are non-refundable once materials have been ordered or work has commenced, unless otherwise stated in writing.

7. Warranties & Limitations

Any applicable warranties will be clearly outlined in your contract. Except where required by law, Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom disclaims any implied warranties beyond those expressly stated.

We are not responsible for normal wear and tear, damage caused by misuse, neglect, or third-party work, or pre-existing conditions not disclosed prior to work.

8. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our website or services.

Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for the services provided.

9. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites for convenience or inspiration. We are not responsible for the content, policies, or practices of those websites.

10. SMS Communications

You must be 18 years of age or older to use this SMS service.

Customers may opt-in to receive email and SMS text message communications through our website (including our contact form at https://tombellcabinetry.com/contact/) and through other promotions or events.

By providing your phone number and opting in, you consent to receive SMS text messages from Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom related to appointments, service updates, project communications, and occasional promotional offers. Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of purchase.

Message frequency varies but promotional messages will not exceed one message per week, excluding appointment reminders which may be sent approximately 48 hours and 1 hour prior to scheduled appointments.

You can cancel the SMS service at any time by replying STOP to any message. After sending STOP, you will receive a confirmation message and will no longer receive SMS messages from us. To rejoin, sign up again through the same opt-in process used initially.

If you experience issues with the messaging program, reply HELP for assistance or contact us directly at sales@tombellcabinetry.com or (615) 469-2781.

Message and data rates may apply for messages sent to you from us and to us from you. For questions about your text plan or data plan, please contact your wireless provider.

Wireless carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

SMS opt-in information and phone numbers collected for SMS communication will not be sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

11. Privacy

Your use of this website is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect and use personal information.

For privacy-related inquiries, please refer to our privacy policy here: https://tombellcabinetry.com/privacy-policy/.

12. Governing Law

These Terms of Service shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of Tennessee, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

13. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of our website or services constitutes acceptance of any updated terms.

14. Contact Us

If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us:

Call or Text: (615) 469-2781
Email: sales@tombellcabinetry.com
